'''[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] second sister''' was one of at least two [[Gender/Legends|female]] children of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] and head of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]] [[Cosinga Palpatine]] and [[Palpatine's mother|his wife]], and sister to Palpatine, future [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Biography==
Palpatine's relationship with his second sister was&mdash;as with all his siblings&mdash;cold. She and the others considered him an interloper&mdash;in turn, he considered them "well-behaved" subservients and held them in contempt.

In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], Palpatine's sister traveled to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in the [[Palpatine family starship|Palpatine family]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] with her father, mother, siblings and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], in order to forcefully recover their eldest brother from Chandrila. After the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Palpatine slaughtered his family and the bodyguards using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], leaving no survivors.

Palpatine remembered the lifeless forms of his siblings slumped on the starship floor every time his Sith master, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], urged him to recall the murders in vivid detail as part of his training in the dark side.
